title: 44 Cool Finds for Holiday Hosting That Make Entertaining Easier
full_text:
Thanksgiving is next week, and the oven and the guest room are about to have their busiest stretch of the year. This guide rounds up holiday hosting finds that make entertaining easier, along with a few hostess gifts for anyone who'd rather not show up empty-handed.
Some products featured in this guide were provided for editorial review. All editorial opinions are my own.
Boards & Grazing
Grazing boards have become the centerpiece of holiday entertaining, and the best ones now pull double duty for the host. Each board below looks good enough to set in front of guests and works just as hard on the counter during prep.
Category Spotlight: Elihome
Elihome
makes its cutting and serving boards from FSC-certified wood fiber, a material that goes in the dishwasher like plastic without the microplastic worries that have sent plenty of cooks shopping for something new. The brand's early Black Friday sale runs now through Nov. 30 at
Elihome.com
with 20% off and a gift with purchase, and
Amazon
takes 20% off all Elihome products Nov. 19-30.
1. Elihome x Peanuts 4-in-1 Cutting Board Set
Four color-coded boards keep raw meat and produce on separate surfaces, which matters when a holiday menu has several dishes going at once. The nonporous boards resist stains and odors, tolerate heat up to 350 degrees and go straight into the dishwasher after the party. The set also landed on USA Today's list of the best home and outdoor products of 2026.
Available on
Elihome.com
2. Kenmore Kenosha Extra Large Acacia Wood Cutting Board
Kenmore cut this extra-large board from solid acacia, a richly colored wood that looks at home on the buffet after a full day of holiday prep. It handles the chopping in the kitchen, then doubles as a beautiful serving platter for sliced meats and charcuterie once dinner starts. Piled high with cheese and cured meats, a board this size becomes the first thing guests crowd around when they walk in the door.
Available on
Amazon
3. WoodenHouse Charcuterie Board with Tray
A slide-out drawer tucked beneath this bamboo board holds the cheese knives and slate labels, so the tools stay with the board instead of rattling around a kitchen drawer. Two bowls and a fruit tray come with the set and give olives and berries their own space on a crowded spread.
Available on
WoodenHouse
4. Farberware Build-a-Board with Clear Locking Lid
Hosts can build a spread the night before and leave it in the fridge under the clear locking lid until guests arrive. The reversible bamboo board has a flat side for chopping and a lipped presentation side that keeps grapes from rolling off, and the lid locks tight enough to carry the whole thing to someone else's party.
Available on
Amazon
5. Packed with Purpose Deluxe Charcuterie Board Gift Basket
Packed with Purpose builds this basket around a maple wood appetizer board and a hand-blown glass spreader, then fills it with sweet and savory artisanal snacks and a soy candle. Every item comes from a mission-driven maker, and this collection supports groups that provide job training for young moms and employment for people with developmental disabilities, among other causes. The host gets a spread ready for the first round of guests and keeps the board long after the crackers disappear.
Available on
Packed with Purpose
Sips & Pours
A drink with a story behind it does a lot of the hosting work, filling the gap while dinner finishes and keeping guests at the table long after dessert. These options cover the sparkling toast, breakfast coffee for houseguests and the last caffeine-free cup of the night.
Category Spotlight: Ayurvedist
Ayurvedist
develops its teas with input from 12 Ayurvedic practitioners and packs them in plastic-free, biodegradable tea bags, with no caffeine, added sugar or "natural flavors" in the blend. Readers can take 10% off the Feast & Focus Duo with
code HOLIDAY-10
, valid Nov. 23 through Dec. 23. The duo is a limited-edition holiday set, available this season only while supplies last.
6. Ayurvedist Feast & Focus Duo
Not every guest wants another glass of wine by 9 p.m., and this pair of caffeine-free teas gives the host something decidedly better to offer than ice water. Be Present brews a striking purple that tends to get a reaction before anyone takes a sip. Be Aligned, warm with turmeric and ginger, makes a cozy follow-up to a heavy holiday dinner, and neither one will keep anyone up past midnight.
Available on
Ayurvedist
7. Roederer Estate 2019 L'Ermitage Gift Set
Wine Enthusiast gave the 2019 L'Ermitage Brut a perfect 100 points, making it the first American sparkling wine to earn that score, and this set pairs it with the Brut Rosé from the same vintage. Hosts can open both for the New Year's toast and let guests taste them side by side, while guests can arrive with the box and hand over a set the host will want to save for a special night. Roederer Estate makes L'Ermitage only in exceptional years, so it carries more weight than the usual bottle grabbed on the way over.
Available on
Roederer Estate
8. Community Coffee Dolly Parton's Cup of Ambition
Dolly Parton named this coffee after a lyric from "9 to 5" and worked with Louisiana-based Community Coffee to develop it in three roasts. Set a bag out for overnight guests, and breakfast the next day starts with a little Southern hospitality and a song most of them will hum before the pot finishes brewing.
Available on
Community Coffee
9. Hotel Chocolat Velvetiser Intro Pack
Hot chocolate brings out the kid in nearly everyone, and the Velvetiser serves the grown-up version without a packet in sight. The machine whisks chocolate into a silky drink, hot or cold, at the touch of a button and tops it with a thin layer of chocolate crema. With more than 170 flavors to choose from, a host can set up a hot cocoa bar and let every guest, young or not, choose a favorite.
Available on
Hotel Chocolat
10. Merry Edwards Sauvignon Blanc Dancing Ladies Gift Set
Etched glasses carry the dancing figures from Merry Edwards' signature label in this set, which packs a pair of them with a bottle of 2024 Russian River Valley Sauvignon Blanc. The wine will be gone by the end of the night, but the glasses stay in the host's cabinet for years, and the logo gift box means it arrives ready to hand over at the door.
Available on
Merry Edwards
Outdoor Entertaining
Cold weather no longer has to send everyone inside after dinner. With the right heat and a little light, guests will happily stay on the patio long after the dishes are cleared.
Category Spotlight: Solo Stove
Solo Stove
built its name on fire pits designed to burn with far less smoke than a traditional backyard fire, and the Texas-based brand has since grown into a full lineup of fire pits and pizza ovens. Its propane models bring that same look to patios where a wood fire isn't allowed or simply isn't practical. Watch for Solo Stove's
Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals
on the Infinity Flame.
/
11. Solo Stove Infinity Flame Fire Pit + Surround Surface
Propane fuels the Infinity Flame, so the fire starts with the push of a button and puts out up to 72,000 BTUs without the smoke and sparks of a wood fire. The removable Surround Surface turns the 42-inch pit into a tabletop when the flames are off, giving guests a place to set drinks and appetizers.
Available on
Solo Stove
12. Big Timber Wood Pellet Patio Heater
Hand-built in Mount Angel, Oregon, the Big Timber burns wood pellets instead of propane and needs no electricity, running on gravity and the stovepipe's draft alone. Guests watch a real fire through glass on three sides while 85,000 BTUs warm everyone within 12 feet. The 20-pound hopper burns for about two hours and refills while the fire runs, so nobody has to interrupt the party to swap a tank.
Available on
Timber Stoves
13. Solo Stove S'mores Bundle
This tabletop Fire Bowl brings s'mores inside, so dessert never depends on the forecast. The bundle pairs the concrete bowl with roasting sticks, gel fuel and a bamboo tray that keeps the graham crackers and chocolate organized, and the whole setup fits on a coffee table or kitchen island.
Available on
Solo Stove
14. BioLite Solar String Lights, 44-Foot Color
Four multicolor LED nodes hang along a 44-foot weather-resistant strand, and six color modes let hosts shift the mood between dinner and a late-night fire. An integrated solar panel charges the lights during the day, and the central hub doubles as a phone charger for the guest whose battery always dies first. For every set sold, BioLite provides safe lighting and charging to a person living in energy poverty.
Available on
BioLite
15. SaluSpa Hot Springs 4-6 Person Square Inflatable Hot Tub
Out-of-town guests get a real perk with this square inflatable hot tub, which seats four to six people and heats water to 104 degrees. Its 140 AirJets create a bubble massage, and built-in Freeze Shield technology lets it stay set up through the colder months. At 77 inches on each side, it sets up on a deck or patio without a contractor or a permanent installation. It also comes in smaller sizes.
Available on
Amazon
The Holiday Table
A holiday table sets the tone before anyone takes a bite. These pieces give hosts a polished starting point and a few built-in conversation starters for the long stretch between courses.
Category Spotlight: Villeroy & Boch
Villeroy & Boch
has made tableware in Germany since 1748, and its porcelain has filled family china cabinets for generations. The brand's newer collections pair that heritage with clean, modern shapes that suit both a holiday dinner and an ordinary Tuesday night. Its Black Friday and Cyber Monday sale takes
up to 70% off Nov. 25-28
.
16. Villeroy & Boch Afina Dinnerware Set, 12 Pieces
White plates let the food take center stage, but plain white can look a little bare on a holiday table. The Afina set fixes that with a faint sunburst relief pressed into the porcelain, just enough texture to look dressed up by candlelight while still working with red and green in December and pastels in April. The 12-piece set serves four, which makes it an easy way to retire a mismatched stack of everyday dishes before the first holiday dinner.
Available on
Villeroy & Boch
17. Conversation Napkin
Printed questions on these reusable cloth napkins give quiet guests an easy way into the conversation and give phones a reason to stay in pockets. They work as well at a holiday dinner with the in-laws as they do at a weeknight meal with the kids, and they come in adult, teen and tween versions.
Available on
Nourish & Gather
18. Lettermade 12 Days of Christmas Napkin Set
Each linen napkin in this set carries an embroidered gift from "The 12 Days of Christmas," so the table matches without every place setting looking the same. Linen gets softer with every wash, so the napkins only get better each December they come out of storage.
Available on
Lettermade
19. Ibu Movement Orchid Napkin Ring
Artisans in Usiacurí, a town on Colombia's Caribbean coast, weave these napkin rings by hand using a technique passed down through generations. The maroon and turquoise colorways add a handmade accent that pairs easily with simple white dinnerware. Ibu Movement, the nonprofit behind them, partners with women artisans around the world so they can earn a living through their craft.
Available on
Ibu Movement
20. The Fête Edit
One digital Fête Edit packs an entire dinner party into a single guide, with chef-inspired menus and a synchronized cooking timeline that tells the host what to start and when. Printable invitations and shopping lists come included, and because it arrives instantly, it makes an easy last-minute gift for the friend who loves to host. Gift cards and memberships to the Monthly Dinner Party Club are also available.
Available on
The Fête Edit
21. Cooper's Hawk Grapevine Wine Decanter
Pouring a bottle into a decanter takes about 30 seconds and makes even a weeknight red feel like a special occasion. This one holds custom-blown glass in a black stainless steel frame on a marble base, so it looks more like a sculpture than barware, and the wine gets time to breathe while the appetizers make their rounds.
Available on
Cooper's Hawk

Zero-Proof Bar
The guest who skips alcohol deserves more than a can of soda and a lime wedge. These alcohol-free drinks taste like someone put real thought into them, and a couple could pass for the real thing in a coupe glass.
22. Culture Pop Sparkling Apple
Culture Pop's newest flavor tastes like crisp apples and sparkling cider, which makes it an easy stand-in for champagne when the kids want to join the midnight toast. Each 12-ounce can carries a live probiotic and 12 grams of sugar, less than half of what's in an 8-ounce glass of sparkling cider. Poured into a flute, it looks the part right next to the bubbly.
Available on
Culture Pop
23. Mingle Espresso Martini Mocktail
Espresso martinis have become a party favorite, and Mingle makes one of the few alcohol-free versions around, pairing rich espresso with dark chocolate in a ready-to-drink can. With 85 milligrams of caffeine, it doubles as the after-dinner pick-me-up for guests who still have a drive home ahead of them. The flavor is a limited edition for the holiday and winter season.
Available on
Mingle Mocktails
24. Tilden Lacewing and Tandem Non-Alcoholic Cocktails
Michelin-recognized restaurants pour Tilden straight over ice, and home hosts can do the same with no shaker or recipe required. Lacewing tastes like cucumber and lychee with a little kick of Szechuan pepper at the end, and Tandem goes darker, with tart cherry and bitter orange that finish on a smoky tea note. Each pour has fewer than 35 calories and no added sugar, so the designated driver gets something just as interesting as everyone else at the table.
Available on
Tilden
25. VAHDAM Advent Calendar Gift Set
VAHDAM packed 24 different teas into this advent calendar, 120 bags in all, so there's plenty to share with whoever is staying over. Hosts can open a door each morning or bring the whole box out after dinner and let guests choose their own blend. It also makes a gift the hostess will still be enjoying on Christmas Eve.
Available on
VAHDAM
Host's Kitchen
The kitchen does the heavy lifting during the holidays, and it somehow ends up as the room where everyone gathers anyway. Everything in this section makes the cooking and cleanup easier and gives guests one more reason to hang around the counter.
26. Ninja SLUSHi Twist Slushie Machine
Ninja's SLUSHi Twist freezes two flavors at the same time, then swirls them into a single drink, which turns any holiday party into a build-your-own slushie stand. Kids can twist lemonade with fruit punch, and the adults can make frozen margaritas in the same machine once the little ones head to bed. One touch handles the slushing, so the host isn't stuck playing bartender all night.
Available on
SharkNinja
27. Cristel 1826 Stainless Steel Frying Pan Set
Holiday cooking means more pans on the stove at once, and these French-made stainless steel frying pans stack neatly when the cabinets are already packed. A three-ply base spreads heat evenly for searing and sauteing, and the pans can go from the stovetop into an oven as hot as 550 degrees, then into the dishwasher once the guests go home.
Available on
Cristel
28. KES 6-Tier Freestanding Pot Rack
Stockpots and Dutch ovens eat up a lot of cabinet space, and this six-tier freestanding rack gives them a place to live in plain sight. Six hooks and shelves rated for up to 250 pounds hold the heavy pieces, so the roasting pan is ready to grab on Thanksgiving morning instead of buried behind the stand mixer.
Available on
Amazon
29. Shark Navigator 2-in-1 Robot Vacuum and Mop
The Shark Navigator vacuums and mops the kitchen floor on its own, picking up cracker crumbs and spilled cider after the last guest leaves. LiDAR navigation maps the whole house, and the self-empty base holds up to 60 days of debris, so the host can skip one more chore during the busiest weeks of the year.
Available on
SharkNinja
30. Lodge 7-Quart Oval Enameled Cast Iron Dutch Oven
Lodge has made cast iron in South Pittsburg, Tennessee, since 1896, and this 7-quart oval Dutch oven holds enough short ribs or chili to feed a full table. The oval shape fits a whole chicken or pork roast, and the enameled interior handles tomato sauce and red wine braises without any seasoning to worry about. When dinner's over, the leftovers can go straight into the fridge in the same pot.
Available on
Lodge
Holiday Baking & Pantry
The pantry gets a serious workout between Thanksgiving and New Year's. These products add new flavor to old family recipes and hand the host a few shortcuts along the way.
31. Healthy On You Greatest Hits Compilation and Zest of Both Worlds
Every blend in this woman-owned San Diego company's six-jar Greatest Hits box is named after a song, so the lineup looks like a track list on the spice rack. The Cardamom Orange blend, Zest of Both Worlds, is the sleeper hit: two tablespoons simmered with a cup of sugar and a cup of water make a holiday syrup for mocktails in about five minutes, and the same jar works in a ham glaze. Every blend is organic and gluten-free with no processed sugar.
Available on
Healthy On You
32. eat2explore Holiday Baking Bundle
Cookie swaps get more interesting with this bundle, which gathers festive treats from different cultures along with easy recipes and the stories behind each one. Kids and grandparents can bake side by side and learn how other families celebrate, which keeps everyone busy while the main course cooks.
Available on
eat2explore
33. Storied Goods Orange Cherry Sugar Cubes
Storied Goods makes these flavored sugar cubes in Virginia, and each one does the work of the simple syrup and muddled orange in an Old Fashioned. Add bourbon and bitters, give it a stir and the drink is done. Guests who skip the bourbon can drop a cube into sparkling wine or hot cider instead and still have something festive in their glass.
Available on
Storied Goods
34. Simply Organic Finishing Sugar 4-Pack
Simply Organic's four finishing sugars come in gingerbread orange, vanilla, chai and spicy cocoa, and a sprinkle on top turns plain sugar cookies or a mug of cocoa into something that looks bakery-made. Hosts can rim a glass with the chai or dust a coffee cake with the spicy cocoa minutes before guests walk in.
Available on
Simply Organic
35. Tumbler Pro Knife Sharpener Bundle
Dull knives make carving the holiday roast harder than it needs to be, and Tumbler's rolling sharpener fixes that without the learning curve of a whetstone. A magnetic holder sets the angle while the diamond sharpener rolls along the blade, so even a first-timer gets a clean edge before the turkey comes out of the oven, and the compact setup looks sleek enough to leave out on the counter between uses.
Available on
Tumbler
Gourmet Gifts for the Host
A bottle of wine is the default hostess gift, but unless it’s fine wine like the ones already mentioned, it usually disappears into the wine rack with a dozen others. These edible gifts are the ones a host will actually open and use.
36. Double Neat Bourbon Milk Chocolate Oreos
Double Neat covers Oreos in bourbon milk chocolate, and a chocolatier in Kunkletown, Pennsylvania, hand-dips each one exclusively for the brand. The packaging is pretty enough that you won't need a gift bag, and any host who keeps a good bottle of bourbon on the bar cart will appreciate them. Once they sell out, there's no guarantee they'll come back.
Available on
Double Neat
37. De Nigris Pearls Collection Gift Pack
This gift pack turns De Nigris balsamic vinegar of Modena into small pearls in several flavors. Spoon a few over a charcuterie board or seared scallops, and a weeknight dish suddenly looks like it came out of a restaurant kitchen.
Available on
Amazon
38. Corto Agrumato-Method Olive Oil Gift Set
Corto grows its olives in California and crushes fresh ingredients right alongside them at the mill, rather than flavoring the oil afterward, a traditional Italian method called agrumato. This year's set pairs a returning Calabrian chili oil with a new horseradish oil, and every annual release since 2021 has sold out. A drizzle of the chili over pizza night or the horseradish over leftover roast beef gives the host a reason to open the box the very next day.
Available on
Corto
39. Piecework x Pasta Rummo Ultimate Italian Pasta Party
Piecework and Pasta Rummo teamed up on a bundle that plans a cozy night in. It comes with three boxes of Rummo pasta, pasta-themed cocktail napkins and a Pasta Time card game to keep the conversation going over dinner. Once the dishes are done, there's a 1,000-piece puzzle of Slim Aarons' "Dining Al Fresco on Capri," a sunny Italian lunch scene that makes a nice break from a gray December. It's a thoughtful thank-you for a host who has spent weeks cooking for everyone else.
Available on
Piecework
Guest-Ready Home
Overnight guests notice the small things, like whether the air mattress holds up until morning and how the guest bath smells. These finds take care of those details before anyone arrives.
40. SleepLux Dream Luxury Air Mattress
When the guest list outgrows the guest room, the SleepLux Dream gives the extra visitor a real bed instead of a sagging one. Its AlwayzAire technology refills the air automatically overnight, and a velvety top keeps the sheets from sliding off. It inflates in about four minutes and packs away once everyone heads home. If the old air mattress in the closet is one you dread pulling out every year, it's time for an upgrade.
Available on
Amazon
41. Wamsutta Supreme Egyptian Cotton Sheet Set
A good night's sleep is what guests remember, and Wamsutta's 600-thread-count Egyptian cotton sateen sheets feel more like a hotel bed than a spare room. The real win is the fitted sheet: a patented 1-inch elastic band runs all the way around it, so the corners stay put instead of popping loose in the middle of the night, and deep pockets fit mattresses up to 20 inches. Each fitted sheet is also labeled top and bottom, which ends the routine of putting it on sideways and starting over.
Available on
Wamsutta
42. Harbor House Living Botswana Animal Print Faux Fur Throw Blanket
Harbor House Living grew out of a Michelin-recognized inn on the California coast, and this throw brings a bit of that hotel comfort to the guest room. Plush faux fur covers one side and soft velvet covers the other, and at 60 by 80 inches it wraps a guest head to toe on a cold night. It also goes in the washing machine on a gentle cycle, so it's fresh again before the next visitor arrives.
Available on
Harbor House Living
43. Panier des Sens Reed Diffuser and Scented Candle
Panier des Sens handcrafts its candles in Provence with fragrances from Grasse, the French town long known for perfume, and each one burns for about 45 hours. The matching reed diffuser keeps an entryway or guest bath smelling fresh without a flame to watch, which matters when the house is full of kids and coats.
Available on
Amazon
44. Shoedles Reusable Shoe Covers
Shoes-off households know the awkward moment when a guest starts unlacing boots in a crowded doorway. Shoedles slip right over shoes as low-profile, machine-washable covers, so guests keep their shoes on and the floors stay clean. They have grip on the bottom, too, so nobody goes sliding across the kitchen. An Extended Fit version covers snow boots and bulkier winter shoes.
Available on
Shoedles
Nobody needs everything on this list to throw a good party, and most hosts will tell you the guests matter more than the gear. A couple of well-chosen pieces aimed at whatever part of hosting you dread most will do more than a cart full of extras.
Product images courtesy of the brands featured.
